description:
4K UHD Singapore Night Scenes - Time Lapse  👍🔔😊

Film with GoPro HERO 8, took me a lot of evenings to form a night lapse of scenic view of different Iconic places of Singapore from sunset till night falls. Hope everyone will like it.
If you love my Work, Help this Channel to Grow by clicking Like and Subscribe button👍🔔😊

Time Stamp
00:00 - Sunset scene
00:20 - Singapore Central Business District
00:39 - Asian Civilisations Museum
00:55 - Gardens By The Bay
01:09 - The Fullerton Hotel
01:21 - Lau Pa Sat
01:34 - Robertson Quay
02:04 - Suntec Singapore
02:15 - Clarke Quay
03:06 - Raffles Hotel
03:25 - Old Hill Street Police Station
